## Summary
- The maintenance page's "Vragen? Neem contact op." linked to `https://stocklistdealer.eu/#contact`. Replaced it with a direct `mailto:contact@stocklistdealer.eu` link, with the address itself as the visible text ("Vragen? Mail naar contact@stocklistdealer.eu.") so it still works when read on paper or from a screenshot.
- Updated `MaintenanceModeTest`'s content assertions to check for the new mailto link and address.
- Updated the R P3-12.1 rule text in `docs/bedrijfsregels/33-p3-integraties.md` to describe the mailto link instead of the old contact link.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter='Maintenance|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity'` — 16 tests, 49 assertions, OK
- [x] Screenshot of the maintenance page at 390px confirms the mailto link renders as expected
